summary: E2E frontend verification of PerProductOverridesPanel Cost £ / List £ / Discounted columns across /admin/materials, /admin/tiles, /admin/flooring. All three managers use the same TierPricingModal and render the 8 new columns in the correct order. Live preview + margin colour + Disable Tier interaction all working. All prior tier modal regression controls still present.

issues: When a product has no list_price/cost/etc. (Cost £ and List £ show '—'), typing a value into Trade Disc renders Discounted as '£0.00' instead of '—'. The review-request contract says Discounted should stay '—' when there are no prices at all. Minor UX polish — no crash, no data corruption. Suggest guarding the preview with `if (listPrice <= 0) return null;` in PerProductOverridesPanel.jsx line ~118.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In PerProductOverridesPanel.jsx discountedPrice IIFE, return null when listPrice <= 0 so empty-price rows keep showing '—' in Discounted even after admin types a Trade Disc value.
critical_code_review_comments: PerProductOverridesPanel.jsx (226 lines) — clean, single responsibility, testids preserved. Only nit: no null-guard on listPrice for the Discounted preview (see design_issues).
seed_data_creation: None. No products were mutated during testing. Trade Disc/Disable Tier inputs were cleared before closing each modal — no overrides persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PerProductOverridesPanel headers verified in this exact order: Product / Cost £ / List £ / Trade Disc / Discounted / Credit % / Disable Tier / Reset. Testids override-cost-{sku}, override-list-{sku}, override-discounted-{sku} all present, one per selected product. Live-computed sample results — Tiles (TEST_NO_CAT_1775766472): cost £23.00, list £54.99, +20% trade → £43.99 with 48% green margin. Flooring (HE7013FSC): cost £12.50, list £62.99, +20% trade → £50.39 with 75% green margin. Materials (355POL6060): cost/list both '—' as expected (matches iter-211 cleanup). Disable Tier checkbox correctly forces Discounted to '—' in all three managers. Cancel button closes the modal cleanly. Only nit: empty-price rows show '£0.00' in Discounted after typing a trade value instead of staying '—'.
rca of the issue: No bug reproduced — main agent's implementation matches the review-request spec on all mandatory criteria. The single minor polish (empty-price rows) is a one-line guard in the discountedPrice IIFE.
